fact_verdicts.note: Page: Navy acquired Oxnard Seacoast Battery as part of a 325 acre lease approved 3 December 1942; lists "Advanced Base Depot - Rifle Range" among other names. Alias match only, as stated.
Page: "By March 1948, the Navy canceled the leases for the 325 acres, including the 19 acre battery site area."
TSHA: "located on a 59,000-acre tract purchased from local landowners beginning in December 1941."
TSHA: "In 1946 the camp was declared surplus, disbanded, and leveled." Nothing on later land use.
EPA profile: landfill "operated from 1974 to 1980"; site about 10 acres.
EPA profile: placed on NPL in 1989 because of contaminated debris, groundwater and soil from landfill operations.
EPA profile: "EPA, Georgia EPD and the site's PRP continue to protect people and the environment" via groundwater monitoring, inspections, Five-Year Reviews.
